Projects.Name: AWS.Bedrock.MEAI
ChangelogMessages: Migrated the Bedrock Microsoft.Extensions.AI integration into the aws-dotnet-ai repository. This package was previously published as AWSSDK.Extensions.Bedrock.MEAI from the aws-sdk-net repository. The AmazonBedrockRuntimeExtensions methods remain in the Amazon.BedrockRuntime namespace; the package's other types now live in the AWS.Bedrock.MEAI namespace.
